correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and parameter inequalities are explicit. The predator nullcline eliminates prey exactly; Descartes multiplicity yields at most two positive equilibria. The \(t=1/\alpha\) reparametrization proves a unique global onset, and derivative signs prove the smaller root is a hyperbolic saddle. Rational brackets and a closed trace lower bound establish the upper example as a sink; the predator-free state has two negative eigenvalues. Standalone exact-symbolic checker verifies algebraic identities and rational witnesses. No finite computation substitutes for the general proof.

value.rationale: The precise ecological gap is rescue of a predator population unable to invade from rarity. The theorem gives a natural complete multiplicity transition and sharp variational critical strength for the entire invasion-failure parameter regime. The exact rational example additionally establishes robust local bistability between predator extinction and positive coexistence, not a routine special-case calculation.
